name: TGorillaVolumetricNoise
definition: A subclass of TGorillaVolumetricMesh that fills its own 3D texture with fractal (FBM) Perlin noise and renders it as a physically based emission-absorption medium.
summary: TGorillaVolumetricNoise generates procedural 3D noise for clouds and smoke, distinguishing itself by baking a smooth density gradient to avoid terracing artifacts common in naive voxel approaches.
